records.source_statement: Fourth ruler affliction is linked to willingness to divorce or hindrance concerning dowry.
limitations: Different possible contexts rather than one guaranteed result.

records.source_statement: Unfortunate Moon beholding ascendant is alleged to bring brawling, separation or dishonest living.
limitations: Source moral allegation without supporting social observation.

records.source_statement: Malefics in fourth or tenth are said to bring quarrels involving parents or injurious people.
limitations: Need both ill planetary status and relevant houses.

records.source_statement: If Moon's separating planet and applying planet do not connect by aspect, author gives an additional argument of contention.
limitations: Intervening relationship, not generic void course.

records.source_statement: Moon in conjunction with Saturn/Mars is said to portend death or misfortune for one partner, with sign gender condition used to decide which.
limitations: Not an authenticated mortality forecast or modern safety advice.

records.source_statement: Moon in trine/sextile with fortunes indicates benefit by friends; square/opposition shows harder gain or quarrels.
Moon aspecting Saturn/Mars, in eighth/twelfth, or void of course is read as trouble, grief, sickness; angular versions associated with separation.
